analysis.headline: Elon Musk, others sign petition for Jensen Huang's return
analysis.summary: Elon Musk and other tech executives signed an online petition urging Nvidia to reinstate ousted CEO Jensen Huang. Reports differ on the petition's size, with one citing more than 115,000 signatures and another, published a day later, citing just over 91,000.
